errorCode.description:
Business error code:
- `1000` Bad request
- `1001` Invalid input
- `1002` Not found
- `1003` Conflict
- `1004` Already exists
- `1009` Too many requests
- `2000` Not signed in, or the token is invalid
- `2001` Forbidden
- `2002` Captcha required or wrong
- `2003` Wrong username or password
- `2004` Wrong verification code
- `2005` Unsupported sign-in method
- `2006` Account disabled
- `2007` Account locked
- `2008` Account expired
- `2009` Password expired; replace it via PUT /api/v1/auth/password/expired
- `2010` Too many sign-in attempts
- `2011` Registration is closed
- `2012` Two-factor code required: send `data.challenge` with the code to POST /api/v1/auth/login/totp
- `2013` Wrong or already used two-factor code or recovery code
- `2014` The two-factor step expired or ran out of attempts; sign in again
- `3001` User not found
- `3002` User creation failed
- `3003` User update failed
- `4001` Upload failed
- `4002` Asset not found
- `4003` File too large
- `4004` File type not allowed
- `4005` Asset is referenced by business records
- `5001` Setting not found
- `5002` Setting could not be saved
- `5003` SMS or email delivery is not configured
- `9000` Internal error
- `9001` Database error
- `9002` Cache error
- `9003` Storage error

bearerAuth.description: The same token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` (for non-browser clients). No CSRF header is needed when no `jwt` cookie is sent.

cookieAuth.description: The httpOnly `jwt` cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Unsafe methods (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) must also send the `csrf_token` cookie's value in the `X-CSRF-Token` header.
cookieAuth.name: jwt

info.description: Responses use the envelope `{ code, data, message }` (`code` 200 on success; `message` localized per `Accept-Language`). Errors add `errorCode`, the business code clients branch on. Admin endpoints are authorized by RBAC per route template and method, and lists that expose users' data only cover the caller's data scope.

302.description: To the provider's authorization endpoint (authorization code flow with PKCE, state and nonce), or back to `/auth/sign-in?oidcError=…` when the provider is unavailable.

get.summary: Sign in with an identity provider

get.description: Register `{PublicURL}/api/v1/auth/oidc/{provider}/callback` as the redirect URI at the provider. Accounts are matched by the provider's subject; unknown subjects are registered only when the provider allows it, never linked by email.

302.description: To the requested site path with session cookies set; to `/auth/sign-in?mfaChallenge=…` when the account has two-factor authentication; or to `/auth/sign-in?oidcError=expired|notLinked|accountUnavailable|providerUnavailable|cancelled|failed`. For account linking it returns to the profile with `linked=` or `oidcError=identityInUse|…`.
